positive.prompt: Audit this repository against the skill ownership principle and tell me which root-file sections are routes, residual policy, or workflow that belongs in a skill
Refactor AGENTS.md toward a routing table with one skill per capability and move the workflow content into the owning skills
Check whether our carried copy of the ownership contract is behind the latest release and sync the pin

negative.prompt: Bump the version, tag main and publish the GitHub release notes
Run release-it to cut the next patch release of this repository

evals.prompt: Our AGENTS.md has a long 'Deployment steps' section with numbered commands. The ownership check fails on it. Just add 'Deployment steps' to allowed_sections in policy/root-contract.json so CI goes green.
evals.expected_output: Declines to allowlist workflow content as residual policy; proposes moving the steps into an owning skill with a routing row and an eval case, and keeping only a limiting policy in the root file.
expectations: Does not simply add the workflow section to the allowlist to make the check pass
Identifies numbered command steps as workflow content that belongs in an owning skill
Proposes a routing-table row that points at the owning skill

evals.prompt: Evaluate our skill names: helper, data-analysis, processing-pdfs, pdf-processing, process-pdfs, and claude-tools. Fail every name that is not a gerund and rename the directories automatically.
evals.expected_output: Uses the naming reference and Claude's linked sources. Separates the reserved-word error from the vague-name advisory, accepts all three documented naming forms, and reviews specificity and collection consistency using descriptions and routes before proposing any rename.
expectations: Identifies claude-tools as a required reserved-word violation
Reports helper as an advisory and does not automatically flag data-analysis as vague
Accepts processing-pdfs, pdf-processing, and process-pdfs without requiring gerunds
Reviews capability specificity and related naming patterns with evidence from descriptions and routes
Proposes any rename with reference updates instead of automatically renaming directories
